translations.web: Moreover he must have good testimony from those who are outside, to avoid falling into reproach and the snare of the devil.
translations.bsb: Furthermore, he must have a good reputation with outsiders, so that he will not fall into disgrace and into the snare of the devil.
translations.kjv: Moreover he must have a good report of them which are without; lest he fall into reproach and the snare of the devil.
translations.asv: Moreover he must have good testimony from them that are without; lest he fall into reproach and the snare of the devil.
